WITH order_payment_agg AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS payment_rows,
    SUM(payment_value) AS order_payment_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment_value IS NULL OR payment_value = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_or_missing_payment_rows
  FROM payments.order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
window_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-08-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-09-01'
),
baseline_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-07-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-08-01'
),
window_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n_orders,
    COUNT(opa.order_id) AS n_orders_with_payment,
    SUM(opa.order_payment_total) AS total_payment_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN opa.order_id IS NULL OR opa.zero_or_missing_payment_rows > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_orders_zero_or_missing_payment,
    AVG(COALESCE(opa.payment_rows, 0)) AS avg_payment_rows_per_order
  FROM window_orders wo
  LEFT JOIN order_payment_agg opa ON wo.order_id = opa.order_id
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n_orders,
    COUNT(opa.order_id) AS n_orders_with_payment,
    SUM(opa.order_payment_total) AS total_payment_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN opa.order_id IS NULL OR opa.zero_or_missing_payment_rows > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_orders_zero_or_missing_payment,
    AVG(COALESCE(opa.payment_rows, 0)) AS avg_payment_rows_per_order
  FROM baseline_orders bo
  LEFT JOIN order_payment_agg opa ON bo.order_id = opa.order_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(w.n_orders, 4) AS value_n_orders,
  ROUND(b.n_orders, 4) AS baseline_n_orders,
  ROUND(w.n_orders_with_payment, 4) AS value_n_orders_with_payment,
  ROUND(b.n_orders_with_payment, 4) AS baseline_n_orders_with_payment,
  ROUND(w.total_payment_value, 4) AS value_total_payment_value,
  ROUND(b.total_payment_value, 4) AS baseline_total_payment_value,
  ROUND(w.n_orders_zero_or_missing_payment, 4) AS value_n_orders_zero_or_missing_payment,
  ROUND(b.n_orders_zero_or_missing_payment, 4) AS baseline_n_orders_zero_or_missing_payment,
  ROUND(w.avg_payment_rows_per_order, 4) AS value_avg_payment_rows_per_order,
  ROUND(b.avg_payment_rows_per_order, 4) AS baseline_avg_payment_rows_per_order
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b;
